change.summary: Move production behavior/resources to their actual domains, remove CurrencyCore/PackCore/MenuSupport runtime owners, preserve original identities, and distribute one portable universal pack.

modifiers.before: Separate CurrencyCore and PackCore source/artifact owners, embedded MenuSupport and duplicate Races mechanics/presentation artifacts.

after.currency: Economy owns all Coin registrations/ledger/merchant/shipping/market/resources in one artifact
after.races: Races owns final mechanics/presentation/native assets with jem_roles save authority; development controls excluded
after.pack_core: Guide/Compat/TwelveEyes/WBT/Server receive their own actual responsibilities/resources; PackCore is removed
after.menus: Required native controls are private to each consuming module, no runtime MenuSupport dependency
after.distribution: Bootstrap included; Professions, Villager Talking, Claims development-only; Workers/Settlements-Workers integration and Saints Dragons excluded
after.portability: Java17 Forge1.20.1,47.4.10, platform-relative runtime ownership for Windows/Linux/macOS

modifiers.before: Deleted owner paths, retired namespace partitions and pre-migration race formulas could remain in current generated views.
modifiers.after: Current source/artifact owners replace deleted owners while historical references remain in history. Full generation removes only obsolete build_atlas-owned partitions. Power projection removes retired Human/Elf bonuses, records final source fire modifiers, keeps development-only Professions conditional, and attaches hash-verified historical numeric evidence only to matching unique IDs; newly observed candidates remain unresolved.

modifiers.before: Shared configuration enabled the selected Bloop1.8Alpha3 shader by default.
modifiers.after: Shared Oculus enableShaders=false. Included shaderpacks remain optional manual choices. No third-party shader source is patched; this avoids forcing an OpenGL4.3 shader on macOS nativeOpenGL4.1.

modifiers.before: Legacy location object for jem_guide:building/7 fails Forge47.4.10 ItemUsedOnLocationTrigger parsing.
modifiers.after: Native location loot-predicate array wrapper; same advancement ID, Chimes2.1.1 tag predicate, parent and completion meaning. Status in testing: source/native parse correctness is distinct from gameplay acceptance.

modifiers.before: Eight baseline test fixture/runner files remained despite disabled production test tasks.
modifiers.after: Remaining seven fixtures and the runner are retired under the explicit no-retained-tests rule; production artifacts unaffected, no tests executed.

rationale.purpose: Move production behavior/resources to their actual domains, remove CurrencyCore/PackCore/MenuSupport runtime owners, preserve original identities, and distribute one portable universal pack.
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly requested execution of the Universal Standalone plan on 2026-10-21, with repository plan amendments and Windows/Linux/macOS portability.
rationale.user_requested: One shared production implementation for integrated/dedicated worlds, source-domain ownership, optional feature absence, Economy ON/OFF, preserved native IDs/saves/behavior, dedicated opt-in events, content-aware progression/quests, Bootstrap in shareable pack.
rationale.codex_choices: Domain adapters, exact generation-bound recipe reconciliation, per-world frozen progression profile, native quest folder projection and source/resource routing implement that approved contract. No implicit player acceptance is asserted.
